foto_ids.description: Photos uploaded through POST /reports/photos, attached to this submission. Each identifier is single-use and expires if unused.

kontejner_id.description: Known container; settlement is derived and checked by the API.

opis_lokacije.description: Landmark or directions. Does not imply surveyed coordinates.

posrednik_id.description: Active intermediary, required only for posrednik channel.

preciznost_lokacije.description: Coordinate precision. Defaults to gps for supplied coordinates, otherwise opisana or naselje.

tacka.description: Coordinates supplied by the reporter; never a substituted settlement centroid.

velicina.description: Reported problem size; dispatcher may correct it.

broj_ponavljanja.description: How many times it has been recorded. Recurrence is what makes a location a black spot.

geo_preciznost.description: How well the position is known — the canonical dump’s own flag, or `geokodirano` for a spot that only has a derived point. `nepoznato` means the position is not established and must not be drawn as a surveyed one; a centroid locates a village, not a spot (`docs/data-sources.md`).

kanonska_id.description: Canonical illegal dump the spot was derived from, when there is one.

lokacija.description: Where the spot is: the canonical dump’s point when it is linked to one, otherwise its own. Null when neither exists — the Eko Alert placeholder coordinate is never returned as a location.

obrazlozenje.description: Why this recommendation, in words a dispatcher can argue with.
obrazlozenje.example: Čišćeno 2024. i 2025, ponovo se stvara; najbliži kontejner je 2.4 km daleko.

poslednji_put.description: Most recent time it was recorded.

preporuka.description: What to do about it. A black spot carries an action, never only a colour on a map.

prvi_put.description: First time the spot was recorded.

rizik.description: Newest risk score behind the spot. Null while the risk recalculator has not scored its subject yet.

sprovedeno_at.description: When the recommendation was carried out.

komponente.description: Every contributing term of the score, keyed by name. Carried so the list can answer "why is this village on it" — a risk-weighted objective is only defensible if it is explainable.

skor.description: Risk score of the subject this spot is scored through.

subjekat_tip.description: Which subject carries the score: the canonical dump when the spot is linked to one, otherwise its settlement — the same fallback routing applies when a stop has no score of its own.

parametri.description: Cost-model parameters the plan was built with.

tezine.description: Priority weights and thresholds the plan was built with.

greska.description: Last failure, kept even when the fallback then succeeded.

ishod.description: Whether the dispatcher agreed, recorded at triage.

izvor.description: Which classifier answered. Rules run without an API key and after the model fails.

kreirana_at.description: When the report entered the classification queue.

model.description: Model or ruleset that produced the proposal.

nadlezna_sluzba.description: Which service this routes to, derived from the response and the sub-category.

obradjena_at.description: When the proposal was written; null while pending.

obrazlozenje.description: Staff-facing rationale in Serbian. Never shown to the reporter.
obrazlozenje.example: Fotografija pokazuje otpad oko kontejnera udaljenog 18 m; kontejner je na 91%.

pouzdanost.description: Confidence from 0 to 1. Corrected proposals are capped at 0.5.

predlozena_podkategorija.description: Proposed sub-category; decides which crew and which machinery.

predlozeni_duplikat_od.description: Report this one may be repeating; advisory, the duplicate decision stays with staff.

predlozeni_kontejner_id.description: Proposed container; only ever one that was offered as a candidate.

predlozeni_tip_obrade.description: Proposed response category, already checked against the rules staff triage enforces.

prijava_verzija.description: Report version this proposal was computed for; it is stale for any later version.

signali.description: The context the proposal was grounded in.

broj_fotografija.description: Photos the classifier could look at.

broj_kandidata_kontejnera.description: How many containers the classifier was allowed to choose from.

crna_tacka_m.description: Metres to the nearest recorded black spot.

kandidata_za_duplikat.description: Nearby open reports offered as duplicate candidates.

kanonska_deponija_m.description: Metres to the nearest illegal dump in the historical registry; settlement-centroid records are excluded.

najblizi_kontejner_id.description: Nearest candidate container, if any was found.

najblizi_kontejner_m.description: Metres to that container; null when the report has no coordinates.

najblizi_kontejner_punjenje.description: Its last reliable fill reading. Null means no sensor or a faulted one, never an empty container.

telefon.description: Phone in E.164. Public by design: showing it to citizens is the purpose of the listing.

prognoza.description: The newest forecast, or null when there is none: a container with no sensor, or one whose history is too short for a slope. Null is not "empty" — it means the fill level is unknown, and routing covers such a container through its `bez_senzora` term instead.

ima_senzor.description: Whether a sensor is mounted right now. Only with `sa_stanjem`.

lokacija.description: Where the collection point is. Positions of village points are derived from settlement centroids, not surveyed (`docs/data-sources.md`). Only with `sa_stanjem`.

mesto_naziv.description: Name of that collection point. Only with `sa_stanjem`.

naziv.description: The label on the physical unit.

prelivanja_90d.description: Overflow alarms in the last 90 days. Only with `sa_stanjem`.

prognoza.description: Newest forecast, without the curve — `GET /containers/{id}/forecast` has that. Absent when there is none. Only with `sa_stanjem`.

sabirno_mesto_id.description: Collection point the container stands on. Only with `sa_stanjem`.

zapremina_l.description: Container volume in litres. Only with `sa_stanjem`.

ima_rupu.description: Readings were missing in the fitted window.

ocekivano_24h.description: Forecast level in 24 hours, in percent.

ocekivano_48h.description: Forecast level in 48 hours, in percent.

pouzdanost.description: How much history stands behind the curve.

sati_do_kriticnog.description: The same, in hours from now. Negative when it is already critical.

ulazni_podaci_do.description: Last reading that fed it; older than the container’s newest reading means it is stale.

vreme_kriticnog.description: Expected time of reaching 95 %; a time in the past means it is over that level now.

fill_percent.description: Fill level recomputed server-side from the mounting depth, in percent.

measured_at.description: Device clock — the only timestamp that belongs on a fill curve.

orientation.description: `emptying` marks the collection that resets the curve; `tipped` is an incident.

pouzdano.description: False when the reading carried a fault code. Such a reading is shown, but must not raise routing priority.

aktivni_status.description: Device status codes. Anything other than a bare `ok` outranks the measurement.

fill_percent.description: Last reliable fill level in percent, as of `measured_at`. Null means no trustworthy reading — never an empty container.

pouzdano.description: Whether the reading may be acted on: no fault codes, not silent. A blocked sensor reads as full.

tih_od.description: Since when the device has been silent. Silence is a data gap, not an empty container.

trend_pp_po_danu.description: Percentage points per day, as the cached state records it.

materijali.description: Materials the collector accepts; at least one.

telefon.description: Serbian phone number in any usual spelling ("064 123 4567", "+381 64...", "010 123 456"); stored normalised to E.164.

autor.description: Signature shown on the post: a service, not the person who typed it. Defaults to the utility.

kategorija.description: Post category, used for the badge and icon in the feed. Defaults to obavestenje.

naselje_id.description: Settlement the post is about. Null (the default) means the whole municipality; a settlement post stays readable by everyone.

sadrzaj.description: Post body. Blank lines separate paragraphs; the feed keeps line breaks.
sadrzaj.example: Od ponedeljka kamion dolazi sredom umesto cetvrtkom, 07:00-10:00.

slika_url.description: Image URL. There is no upload endpoint yet, so this is a link to an already hosted image.

sms_tekst.description: The same news for citizens without a smartphone, sent by SMS/Viber and to local-community presidents. One message only: 160 characters in plain ASCII, but 70 if it contains c/c/s/z/d, because those force UCS-2 encoding. Null means the post deliberately stays in the app.
sms_tekst.example: Od 22.9. odvoz u Temskoj je SREDOM 07-10h umesto cetvrtkom. JKP Komunalac Pirot.

zakacena.description: Pin the post above newer ones. A schedule change has to outlive a week of other news. Defaults to false.

opis_lokacije.description: Landmark or directions. Does not imply surveyed coordinates.

preciznost_lokacije.description: Coordinate precision. Defaults to gps for supplied coordinates, otherwise opisana or naselje.

tacka.description: Coordinates supplied by the reporter; never a substituted settlement centroid.

velicina.description: Reported problem size; dispatcher may correct it.

latencyMs.description: Round-trip time of that query, in milliseconds. Absent when unreachable.

reachable.description: Whether a trivial query against the database succeeded.

upit.description: What the citizen wants to get rid of, as typed: any script, dialect or spelling. Capped because every character is sent to a paid model.
upit.example: imam star šporet i ormar od iverice

adresa.description: Address or location description; says "približno" when the point is approximate.

geo_preciznost.description: How exact the point is: a geocoded street is not a surveyed gate.

izvor.description: Where this site came from. Every site on the map has one.

materijali.description: What the site takes, in the shared vocabulary; the disposal search matches on this. May be empty.

naziv.description: Name as the site is known.
naziv.example: Otkup i prodaja sekundarnih sirovina KROLUKS

prima.description: What the site takes, in its own words.

tip.description: What the site is (icon and map filter). Not what it takes — see materijali.

izvor.description: Which classifier answered: the OpenAI model, or the keyword table it falls back to when unconfigured, slow or failing. Diagnostic — lets a tester see which path ran.

kontakt.description: Always present: the regional landfill operator, for anything the list does not cover.

materijal.description: Recognised material, in the vocabulary sites and collectors use for what they take. Null when the text is not about disposal or is too unclear.

sakupljaci.description: Collectors who accept the recognised material; empty when none do or nothing was recognised.

upit.example: imam star šporet i ormar od iverice

aktivna.description: Whether the site still stands. False only for a cleared or remediated one — and a cleared site whose sources say it refills is true again, because the LPUO records that a cleared site returns unless a container replaces it. Absence from later reports is not closure: the 2017/2018 break is a change of reporting method (`docs/data-sources.md`).

broj_izvornih_redova.description: Source rows merged into this one site.

broj_opservacija.description: Dated observations underneath it. A lower bound, never a count of dumps: one row can read "a dozen dumps near Izvor".

broj_prijava.description: Confirmed citizen reports filed against this site. Separate from `broj_opservacija` on purpose: that one counts what the CSV import owns and may never be added to this, because a count of reports grows with app adoption rather than with dumping (`docs/data-sources.md`).

geo_preciznost.description: How the coordinate was obtained. Only `registarska_tacka` is a surveyed point; a centroid locates the village, not the dump, and must not be rendered as if someone had stood on it.

godine_evidentirana.description: Every year it was recorded. A gap is not evidence it was gone: 2017 has no Pirot rows at all and the 2018 locations never reappear, which is a change of reporting method rather than a drop in dumping.

kanonski_id.description: The identity the register and the UI quote.

lokacija.description: Where it is. Null exactly when `geo_preciznost` is `nepoznato`: a dump whose location was never recorded is not drawable, and the Eko Alert placeholder coordinate is not a location (`docs/data-sources.md`).

naselje_id.description: Settlement it was matched to, when the name could be resolved.

naziv.description: Name as the sources give it; several merged names are joined with " | ".

ociscena_datum.description: Most recent clean-up recorded on any merged source row.

ponovo_se_stvara.description: Whether it refills after being cleared — the signal that turns a site into a black spot.

poslednja_prijava_at.description: Most recent confirmed report about it.

poslednji_put_zabelezena.description: Last year it appears in any source.

povrsina_m2.description: Largest area any merged source row reports, in m². The sources disagree, so this is a maximum rather than a sum.

prvi_put_zabelezena.description: First year it appears in any source.

spajanje_pouzdanost.description: How confident the merge of the source rows was. `srednja` has to stay visible: it is one site only if the reasoning holds.

stanje.description: `status` reduced to the five states the register actually distinguishes, read off the leading clause. Derived here rather than in every client, because the same reduction is what `sve=false` filters on.

status.description: Status verbatim from the sources, not a vocabulary.
status.example: nije prijavljena posle 2018; evidentirana u LPUO 2021-2031

items.description: Canonical dumps, ordered by their register id.

ima_rupu.description: Readings were missing in the fitted window. Gaps are marked, never interpolated away.

model_verzija.description: Model and the parameters it ran with.

pouzdanost.description: How much history stands behind the curve. Low means little history, a gap, or an untrustworthy device.

serija.description: Forecast curve, one point per six hours, first point at the moment of computation.

ulazni_podaci_do.description: Last reading that fed the forecast. Older than the container’s newest reading means the forecast is stale.

vreme_kriticnog.description: When the container is expected to reach 95 %, the level at which it counts as overflowing. A time in the past means it is over that level now. Null when the curve does not reach it inside the horizon. The curve is free-running: it assumes nobody collects, so a scheduled collection does not clear this field.

parametri.description: Overrides for the cost model; omitted keys keep their defaults.

tezine.description: Overrides for the priority weights; omitted keys keep their defaults.

ciljFunkcija.description: The weights and cost model the plans were built with.

datum.description: The day that was planned, YYYY-MM-DD.

nepokriveno.description: Must-visit stops no vehicle could take. Reported so a dispatcher can act, never silently dropped.

planovi.description: One plan per active vehicle that received at least one stop.

preskocenaLista.description: The optional stops themselves, with their priority and why they scored that — so "why isn't X on the route" never needs a database query. A stop here was seen and scored, just not worth the detour today.

preskoceno.description: Optional stops left for another day because the detour was not worth it.

database.description: Database reachability, omitted when the check could not be run.

status.description: Overall service status. Degraded means the database is unreachable.

uptimeSeconds.description: Seconds the process has been running.

version.description: Deployed version of the service, from package.json.

imaOcitavanje.description: Whether ocekivanoPunjenje is a real, trustworthy measurement. False for a container with no sensor mounted or whose last reading carried a diagnostic fault — sensor-telemetry.md: a missing reading is a gap, never a reassuring 0%. Render 'no data', not a fill bar, when this is false.

komponente.description: Every term of the priority function for this container. Keys are the term names.

obavezno.description: Whether this container alone forces the stop, regardless of distance: forecast critical within 48h, a reliable reading ≥80%, an open confirmed report, or prioritet at or above tezine.prag_obaveznog.

ocekivanoPunjenje.description: Fill level the truck should expect on arrival, 0..100. Meaningless when imaOcitavanje is false — 0 there means no trustworthy reading exists, never a measured empty container.

oznaka.description: The label on the physical unit.

prijavaId.description: The confirmed citizen report about this specific container, if any.

razlog.description: The single strongest reason this container is on the list.

naziv.description: Settlement name, container label or intermediary name.

items.description: Reference items without phone numbers or other private contact data.

MaterijalOtpada.description: What the site takes, in the shared vocabulary; the disposal search matches on this. May be empty.

items.description: Posts in feed order: pinned first, then newest, with a stable identifier tie-breaker.

azurirana_at.description: Last edit instant; null when the post has never been edited.

naselje_id.description: Settlement the post is about; null means the whole municipality.

objavljena_at.description: Publication instant; editing does not move it.

sadrzaj.description: Post body with line breaks preserved.

slika_url.description: Image URL, if the post has one.

zakacena.description: Pin the post above newer ones. A schedule change has to outlive a week of other news. Defaults to false.

info.description: Contract-first API. This document is generated from the NestJS source; it is never hand-edited.
info.title: Hackaton API

post.description: Verifies credentials and returns a 30-minute bearer token. Limits attempts by IP and normalized email.

400.description: Invalid email or password shape.

401.description: Invalid credentials, inactive account or expired token.

get.description: Checks current account activation and returns the current role without credentials.

200.description: Active staff identity and current role.

401.description: Invalid credentials, inactive account or expired token.

get.description: Every registered collector with the materials they accept, sorted by last name.

post.description: Adds a collector with first name, last name, phone and accepted materials. The phone is normalised to E.164 and must be unique.

400.description: Invalid input or a phone that is not a Serbian number.

409.description: A collector with this phone number already exists.

delete.description: Removes the collector; their number stops appearing in search results immediately.

get.description: Active containers at active collection points, ordered by label. Returns identifiers and labels by default; with `sa_stanjem` also the location, the cached fill state and a forecast summary without the curve.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive search on the container label.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Include the current state and the forecast summary. Off by default, so the reference lookup used while filing a report stays small.
parameters.name: sa_stanjem

parameters.description: Only containers with a sensor mounted right now.
parameters.name: samo_sa_senzorom

parameters.description: Only containers whose last reliable reading is at or above this percentage.
parameters.name: min_fill

parameters.description: Only containers forecast to reach 95 % before this instant. Containers without a forecast are not included — nothing says they are critical.
parameters.name: kriticno_do

400.description: Invalid query.

get.description: Always includes the state and the forecast summary; the forecast curve itself is a separate call.

400.description: Invalid query.

get.summary: One container with its state and forecast summary

get.description: The newest stored forecast: the curve with its p10/p90 band and the expected time of reaching 95 %. Returns `prognoza: null` for a container that has one but no forecast — no sensor, or too little history.

200.description: The container and its newest forecast, which may be null.

get.summary: Read the fill forecast for one container

get.description: Readings oldest first, for the requested number of days back. Unreliable readings are included and flagged, not filtered: hiding them would turn a device fault into an invisible gap.

parameters.description: How many days back to read.
parameters.name: dana

200.description: Readings, possibly empty for a container with no sensor.

400.description: Invalid query.

get.summary: Measured fill history of one container

get.description: Real, sourced sites with what each takes. The disposal search matches on materijali.
get.summary: List drop-off sites for the citizen map

post.description: Classifies free Serbian text (any script, dialect or spelling) into a material and lists collectors who take it, plus the regional landfill operator as a fallback contact.

200.description: Recognised material, matching collectors and the default contact.

400.description: Query missing, too short or over 200 characters.

429.description: Too many searches from this address; try again later.

post.summary: Recognise what a citizen wants to dispose of

get.description: The merged dump register for Pirot, ordered by register id, each row carrying the years it was recorded, the sources it came from and how well its coordinate is known. Cleared and remediated sites are left out unless `sve` asks for them — but a cleared site the sources record as refilling stays in, because clearing without a container is not a fix. `sa_lokacijom` drops the ones a map cannot draw.

parameters.description: Maximum items per page. The whole Pirot record is well under one page, so the map fetches it in a single call.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only dumps matched to this settlement.
parameters.name: naselje_id

parameters.description: Only dumps that have a coordinate. A map wants this; a count of the record does not, because dropping the unlocated ones undercounts the register.
parameters.name: sa_lokacijom

parameters.description: Include cleared and remediated sites too — the whole register rather than what still stands. Off by default: the map asks what is there now, and a cleared site that has not come back is not.
parameters.name: sve

400.description: Invalid query.

get.summary: List illegal dumps that still stand

get.description: Returns service status, version, uptime and database reachability.

200.description: The service is reachable and reports its status.

get.description: Lists active intermediaries without exposing phone numbers.

200.description: Intermediary names and identifiers without contact data.

400.description: Invalid lookup query.

get.description: Returns posts in feed order: pinned first, then newest. A settlement filter also returns municipality-wide posts.

parameters.description: Settlement feed: returns posts for this settlement PLUS municipality-wide ones, because a village feed without the municipal news is missing half of it.
parameters.name: naselje_id

400.description: Invalid input, unknown settlement or SMS text longer than one message.

post.description: Publishes immediately to the citizen feed. The optional SMS text is the copy for citizens without a smartphone and must fit one message.

delete.description: Removes the post from the feed. Messages already sent by SMS or Viber are not recalled.

400.description: Invalid input, unknown settlement or SMS text longer than one message.

patch.description: Requires the current version. Omitted fields keep their value, an explicit null clears one, and pinning is the zakacena field. Publication time does not change.

200.description: The edited post and its new version.

400.description: Invalid input, unknown settlement or SMS text longer than one message.

409.description: Stale version: the post was edited by someone else.

post.description: Stores an image and returns a single-use identifier to pass as foto_ids on the submission that follows. Unclaimed uploads expire. The image type is determined from the file content, not from the request header.

foto.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC image.

201.description: Stored photo and its public address.

400.description: Invalid input, location or business rule.

409.description: Stale version, invalid transition or idempotency conflict.

413.description: Photo exceeds the configured size limit.

415.description: File content is not an accepted image type.

get.description: Returns report content and immutable versioned history for utility staff.

400.description: Invalid input, location or business rule.

409.description: Stale version, invalid transition or idempotency conflict.

get.summary: Read a report and its audit history

post.description: Recomputes the triage proposal for the current report version and returns it. Advisory only: the report itself is unchanged, and the dispatcher still confirms through triage. A failed model call falls back to the rule classifier rather than leaving the request pending.

200.description: The proposal for the current report version.

post.description: Deletes a photo that should not stay public - a face, a number plate, a house number. POST rather than DELETE because the reason is required and is recorded in the report history. The report version is unchanged.

400.description: Invalid input, location or business rule.

404.description: Unknown report, or the photo does not belong to it.

409.description: Stale version, invalid transition or idempotency conflict.

400.description: Invalid input, location or business rule.

409.description: Stale version, invalid transition or idempotency conflict.

post.summary: Record completed work on a confirmed report

post.description: Requires the current version and an explanation. Confirmation selects a response category; closed reports cannot be changed.

400.description: Invalid input, location or business rule.

409.description: Stale version, invalid transition or idempotency conflict.

get.description: Recurring illegal-dump locations that are still open — neither carried out nor dismissed — each with its recommendation and the newest risk score behind it, most urgent first. `sve` includes the closed ones.

parameters.description: Only black spots in this settlement.
parameters.name: naselje_id

parameters.description: Only black spots carrying this recommendation.
parameters.name: preporuka

parameters.description: Only spots recorded at least this many times. A single sighting is not yet a black spot.
parameters.name: min_ponavljanja

parameters.description: Include closed black spots — those carried out or dismissed. Off by default: the list answers "what is still open", and a cleared spot returns to it only by recurring.
parameters.name: sve

400.description: Invalid query.

get.description: Every generated plan for the day, newest generation first. Defaults to today.

parameters.description: Day to list plans for, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: datum

200.description: Plans for the day, possibly empty.

get.summary: List route plans for a day

post.description: Scores every active collection point (forecast overflow, dump risk, confirmed reports, coverage), then builds one route per active vehicle. Plans are stored as proposals for a dispatcher to approve. Must-visit stops that no vehicle could take are returned as `nepokriveno`, never dropped.

201.description: The generated plans, one per vehicle with stops.

get.description: The plan as stored, including the priority components of every stop.
get.summary: One route plan with its stops
